Message.Name: Login Accepted Message
Message.Description: Sent to indicate a successful login. Carries the current version of the Nyse ArcaBook protocol.

Field.Name: Version ID
Field.Description: Version of the Nyse ArcaBook protocol, formatted vv.vv.

Field.Name: Padding
Field.Description: Not used.

Message.Name: Login Rejected Message
Message.Description: Sent when login fails authentication, the client does not log in within 5 seconds, no order data feed was subscribed to, the sequence number was invalid, no connections are available, or a timeout occurred. The socket is closed afterwards.

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: The reason the login was rejected.

Field.Name: Padding
Field.Description: Not used.

Message.Name: Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Sent every 60 seconds during periods of client inactivity, so that firewalls do not time the connection out. The client must answer with a Heartbeat Response. There is no message body, and the header length is always zero.

Message.Name: Test Response Message
Message.Description: Sent in response to a Test Request, echoing back any text the request carried.

Field.Name: Test Message
Field.Description: Text sent in the Test Request message.

Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: Sent for a new open order. The Order Reference Number is unique per order book, while the Sequence Number is unique across all order books.

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Message creation timestamp in milliseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Message sequence number, 1 to 2147483647.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The unique reference number per order book (system code) assigned to this order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The size of the order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit price of the bond order. See Bond Price Types.

Field.Name: Price Scale Code
Field.Description: The power of ten dividing the price fields in this message.

Field.Name: Exchange Code
Field.Description: Whether this is a Nyse listed bond.

Field.Name: System Code
Field.Description: Which order book this order belongs to.

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: Whether this is a buy or a sell order.

Field.Name: Flat Pricing
Field.Description: Whether flat pricing or interest pricing is in effect.

Field.Name: Trading Action
Field.Description: The current state of trading for this bond.

Field.Name: Security Type
Field.Description: The type of bond. Additional types will be supported in future releases.

Field.Name: Order Type
Field.Description: Whether the order is All or None, Minimum Quantity, or unspecified.

Field.Name: NYSE Bond Symbol
Field.Description: A Nyse Bonds specific identity for this bond.

Field.Name: CUSIP / ISIN
Field.Description: Cusip or Isin for the bond. Null unless the client requested the data and holds a licence.

Field.Name: Quote ID
Field.Description: 'A' plus the Mmid when attributed, otherwise 'ARCAX'.

Field.Name: Padding
Field.Description: Not used.

Field.Name: Minimum Quantity
Field.Description: For an All or None order the size of the order, for a Minimum Quantity order the minimum size of the order, and 0 for other order types.

Message.Name: Imbalance Message
Message.Description: Sent in response to orders submitted during pending auctions, at the conclusion of the Opening, Market Order and Closing Auctions, and for Halt Auctions. Total and market imbalance volumes are negative for a sell imbalance.

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Message creation timestamp in milliseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Message sequence number, 1 to 2147483647.

Field.Name: Match Quantity
Field.Description: The indicative match volume.

Field.Name: Total Imbalance
Field.Description: The total imbalance volume.

Field.Name: Market Imbalance
Field.Description: The market imbalance volume.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The indicative match price.

Field.Name: Price Scale Code
Field.Description: The power of ten dividing the price fields in this message.

Field.Name: Exchange Code
Field.Description: Whether this is a Nyse listed bond.

Field.Name: System Code
Field.Description: Which order book this imbalance belongs to.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Which auction this imbalance is for.

Field.Name: Flat Pricing
Field.Description: Whether flat pricing or interest pricing is in effect.

Field.Name: Trading Action
Field.Description: The current state of trading for this bond.

Field.Name: Security Type
Field.Description: The type of bond.

Field.Name: Quote Condition
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: NYSE Bond Symbol
Field.Description: A Nyse Bonds specific identity for this bond.

Field.Name: CUSIP / ISIN
Field.Description: Cusip or Isin for the bond. Null unless the client requested the data and holds a licence.

Field.Name: Auction Time
Field.Description: Projected auction time, formatted hhmm.

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: Sent to indicate a special system event to an order book. The Event Code says what happened and the System Code which book is affected. Also carries the next sequence number subscribers should expect, which is generally the current one plus one but may restart at 1.

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Message creation timestamp in milliseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: The sequence number of this message, 1 to 2147483647.

Field.Name: Next Expected Sequence Number
Field.Description: The sequence number that subscribers should expect next.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: What type of event has occurred.

Field.Name: System Code
Field.Description: Which order book is affected.

Field.Name: NYSE Bond Symbol
Field.Description: A Nyse Bonds specific identity for this bond.

Field.Name: CUSIP / ISIN
Field.Description: Cusip or Isin for the bond. Null unless the client requested the data and holds a licence.

Field.Name: Padding
Field.Description: Not used.
